mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal a monetary tightening cycle combined with labor market weakness, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) reflects robust residential construction activity, boosting economic growth and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized inflation exceeds 3.5% (computed from CPIAUCSL), it triggers central bank hawkishness and risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
